title: Fast Graph Laplacian Estimation using Effective Resistance
abstract: arXiv:2609.23668v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Inferring network topology from noisy node observations is a central problem in graph signal processing. In this paper, we consider Laplacian-constrained graph estimation for Gaussian Markov random fields, focusing on the underdetermined regime in which the number of samples is smaller than the number of graph nodes. Existing approaches often formulate the problem as a sparsity-regularized maximum-likelihood estimation problem. While effective, such methods typically require iterative optimization and are often computationally demanding, particularly under Laplacian constraints. Instead, we propose a non-iterative estimator of graph Laplacians that uses effective resistance for regularization, and evaluate the method using a simple sparsification procedure. Experiments show that with some trade-off in edge and weight recovery on the considered dataset, computational cost for moderately sized graphs can be substantially reduced.

translated_title: 基于有效电阻的快速图拉普拉斯估计
translated_abstract: 从含噪节点观测中推断网络拓扑是图信号处理中的一个核心问题。本文考虑高斯马尔可夫随机场的拉普拉斯约束图估计问题，重点关注样本数量少于图节点数量的欠定情形。现有方法通常将该问题表述为稀疏正则化的最大似然估计问题，这类方法虽然有效，但通常需要迭代优化，且计算开销较大，尤其是在拉普拉斯约束下。作为替代，我们提出了一种利用有效电阻进行正则化的非迭代图拉普拉斯估计器，并通过简单的稀疏化流程对该方法进行评估。实验表明，在所考虑的数据集上，尽管在边和权重的恢复方面存在一定折中，但中等规模图的计算成本可以大幅降低。
tldr: 提出了一种利用有效电阻正则化的非迭代图拉普拉斯估计方法，在样本数少于节点数的欠定情形下，以一定的边与权重恢复精度为代价，大幅降低了中等规模图的计算成本。
en_tdlr: We propose a non-iterative graph Laplacian estimator regularized by effective resistance, which substantially reduces computational cost for moderately sized graphs in the underdetermined regime where samples are fewer than nodes.
